001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.QuickShopAPI;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.inventory.ShopInventory;
005import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.meta.ShopDisplay;
006import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.meta.ShopExtraHolder;
007import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.meta.ShopMeta;
008import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.ShopPermission;
009import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.trading.ShopTrading;
010import org.bukkit.NamespacedKey;
011import org.bukkit.block.Block;
012import org.bukkit.configuration.ConfigurationSection;
013import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
014import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;
015import org.jetbrains.annotations.ApiStatus;
016import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
017import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
018
019import java.util.HashMap;
020import java.util.Map;
021import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
022
023/**
024 * A shop
025 */
026public interface Shop<U, L> extends Locatable<L>, ShopInventory, ShopMeta<U>, ShopTrading, ShopDisplay, ShopPermission, ShopExtraHolder {
027
028  NamespacedKey SHOP_NAMESPACED_KEY = new NamespacedKey(QuickShopAPI.getPluginInstance(), "shopsign");
029
030  /**
031   * Get shop's item durability, if have.
032   *
033   * @return Shop's item durability
034   */
035  short getDurability();
036
037  /**
038   * Getting ConfigurationSection (extra data) instance of your plugin namespace)
039   *
040   * @param plugin The plugin and plugin name will used for namespace
041   *
042   * @return ExtraSection, save it through Shop#setExtra. If you don't save it, it may randomly lose
043   * or save
044   */
045  @Deprecated(forRemoval = true)
046  @ApiStatus.ScheduledForRemoval(inVersion = "6.4.0.0")
047  @NotNull
048  ConfigurationSection getExtra(@NotNull Plugin plugin);
049
050  /**
051   * Check shop is or not attached the target block
052   *
053   * @param paramBlock Target {@link Block}
054   *
055   * @return isAttached
056   */
057  boolean isAttached(@NotNull Block paramBlock);
058
059  /**
060   * Gets if shop is dirty (so shop will be save)
061   *
062   * @return Is dirty
063   */
064  boolean isDirty();
065
066  /**
067   * Sets dirty status
068   *
069   * @param isDirty Shop is dirty
070   */
071  void setDirty(boolean isDirty);
072
073  /**
074   * Get this container shop is loaded or unloaded.
075   *
076   * @return Loaded
077   */
078  boolean isLoaded();
079
080  /**
081   * Whether Shop is valid
082   *
083   * @return status
084   */
085  boolean isValid();
086
087  /**
088   * Execute codes when player click the shop will did things
089   */
090  void onClick(@NotNull Player clicker);
091
092
093  @Deprecated()
094  @ApiStatus.Internal
095  void handleLoading();
096
097  @Deprecated()
098  @ApiStatus.Internal
099  void handleUnloading(boolean dontTouchWorld);
100
101  /**
102   * open a preview for shop item
103   *
104   * @param player The viewer {@link Player}
105   */
106  void openPreview(@NotNull Player player);
107
108  /**
109   * Getting ShopInfoStorage that you can use for storage the shop data
110   *
111   * @return ShopInfoStorage
112   */
113  ShopInfoStorage saveToInfoStorage();
114
115  /**
116   * Gets the symbol link that created by InventoryWrapperManager
117   *
118   * @return InventoryWrapper
119   */
120  @NotNull
121  String saveToSymbolLink();
122
123  /**
124   * Sets shop is dirty
125   */
126  void setDirty();
127
128  /**
129   * Save the extra data to the shop.
130   *
131   * @param plugin Plugin instance
132   * @param data   The data table, or null to remove it
133   */
134  @Deprecated(forRemoval = true)
135  @ApiStatus.ScheduledForRemoval(inVersion = "6.4.0.0")
136  default void setExtra(@NotNull final Plugin plugin, @Nullable final ConfigurationSection data) {
137    if (data == null) {
138      return;
139    }
140
141    final Map<String, String> extra = new HashMap<>();
142    data.getValues(true).forEach((k, v) -> extra.put(k, String.valueOf(v)));
143
144    setExtra(plugin, extra);
145  }
146
147  /**
148   * Update shop data to database
149   */
150  @NotNull
151  CompletableFuture<Void> update();
152
153  /**
154   * Update shop data to database synchronously. This will create the completeable future for the save
155   * function, and wait for it to complete. DON'T USE IF YOU DON'T KNOW WHAT YOU'RE DOING!
156   *
157   * @throws RuntimeException
158   */
159  void updateSync() throws RuntimeException;
160}
